title: Fix MiniMap dark mode broken by Tailwind !important override
description: The MiniMap component in flow-canvas.tsx (line 534-537) uses className="!bg-white !border-gray-200". The ! prefix generates CSS !important declarations, which override the dark mode styles in index.css (.dark .react-flow__minimap { background-color: #1f2937; border: 1px solid #374151 }). Result: in dark mode the minimap appears as a bright white rectangle with light border — a visible regression. Fix: Either (a) remove the ! prefix and add dark mode variants: className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700", or (b) add !important to the dark CSS rule in index.css. Option (a) is preferred. Alternatively, this will be fully resolved when the colorMode prop is adopted (task 3_use-reactflow-colormode-prop), but that's a larger refactor. This is a quick 1-line fix.
